name: Speed Creators
detailed_description:
Race against your friends in one massive sprawling platformer level created by you and your friends!

First everyone is given a time limit to create and beat a small level. Then all levels that make it through are stitched together with checkpoints along the way. Then run for glory as you watch your friends slowly go insane trying to beat your level.

Use traps and blocks with special properties to make your level however you want, whether that's tough as nails platforming or a satisfying parkour challenge.  How the final level turns out is entirely up to the nature of the players.

Cool Features-

Online multiplayer for anywhere from 2-200 players

Dozens of unique traps and blocks with different effects and utilities

A special bond with your level that results in a one of a kind feeling as you watch your friends slowly lose their minds on your own creation

Simple yet precise platforming

Punch your friends

Modifiers that let you control how the game is played

Precise and engaging platforming

Create, play, and share custom levels online

Hats, lots of hats

Though a primarily multiplayer game, you can create your own levels offline in a solo level editor and share them online.
